name: MeshClient
description: A Meshtastic client for your handheld: read and send messages, browse the mesh, and edit your radio's settings over Bluetooth LE or USB.
author: mcereal

changelog.v2.56.1: Adopt a connect's host as the one to go back to; Route a network row's press to the network transport.
changelog.v2.56.0: Reach a Meshtastic node over the network; A network link is not a Bluetooth radio; Four findings from review.
changelog.v2.55.0: Make an arriving message visible from anywhere; Three notification bugs from review.
changelog.v2.54.1: Open the drive without testing it first; Hold the drive, and read a write that ended as a restart.
changelog.v2.54.0: Add USB (adb) transport to the device deploy loop.
